headline: The regulator mandated the ledger first.
body: SEBI has required a distributed ledger for corporate-bond covenant monitoring since April 2022. The depositories, NSDL and CDSL, run it, and no corporate bond activates without it.

headline: The first tokenised bonds are live.
body: In September 2026 the RBI and SEBI launched a tokenised corporate-bond rail together. It raised ₹1,025 crore across three issuers, settled in wholesale CBDC.

headline: The markets are large and slow.
body: India has ₹53.6 lakh crore of corporate bonds outstanding and trades about ₹7,645 crore of them a day. Away from the exchange a trade can take three to seven days to settle.

headline: The flows are the world's largest.
body: India receives $135 billion a year in remittances, more than any other country.
